capabilities: verify the integrity and conformance of sealed notes
seal notes with a hash payload and optional re-seal on save
record local trusted or rejected trust verdicts
file verified objects into colored portfolio folders
view adaptation lineage and a 3D globe of sealed objects
disambiguation: Not a note-preview or magnifier tool; it verifies, seals, and organizes notes carrying KNOBE Protocol seal blocks.
extras: README stresses that a verified seal proves integrity, not truth or safety, and that quarantine status stays visible by default. Install is recommended via BRAT for beta releases, with manual and from-source options also documented.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to check that a note's embedded provenance payload is intact or to record local trust decisions about such files.

relations.evidence: BRAT is optional: it is only a convenient way to install and update beta releases.
Faithful port of the reference lens.py (KnobeOne/knobe-protocol 6132595), gated against the 9 published conformance vectors

summary: Verifier and sealer for KNOBE Protocol v1 hash-sealed Markdown notes, adding a dashboard, trust verdicts, a lineage graph, and a 3D globe.
